Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: Alma's intro value-prop carousel - a cream onboarding screen where swiping pages through product previews: a goals card with colored nutrient bubbles, a journal entry card answering "What am I missing?", and a "coming soon" recipes card with dish photography.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Cream onboarding screen: small logo and Sign in top, a rounded white preview card at center, the headline "The easiest way to..." with a changing subline ("Track what you eat", "Learn how your diet affects you"), page dots, and a dark green Get Started pill. Pages: a goals recap card with red/green/yellow bubble clusters, a Journal Entry card with the entry "Eating well but dragging at the gym. What am I missing?" and an AI answer, and a "And coming soon..." recipes card ("Dishes of the Week", Vegan/Salmon dishes).

## Motion spec
Pattern: swipeable card carousel, gesture-driven ~400ms per page.
- Swipe: the card track follows the finger 1:1; on release it settles to the nearest page (spring ~320/24), the incoming card scaling 0.94 -> 1 while the outgoing drops to 0.94.
- Text: headline stays fixed; the subline cross-fades per page (200ms).
- Dots: the active dot widens (8px -> 20px, 250ms ease-out) and darkens; others shrink.
- Edge: the next card peeks in from the side during the drag, clipped by the screen edge.

## Calibration
- Card corners stay constant; only scale and position animate.
- The Get Started button and header never move across pages.

## Reduced motion
Pages cross-fade (250ms); dots switch without stretch.

## Don't miss
- The mid-swipe frame shows two cards at once with real parallax - no fake page curl.
- The recipes page reveals a second headline ("And coming soon...") that replaces the first.
